title: Failover and fencing
brief: Transfer write authority safely while accounting for divergent or missing history.
outcomes: Separate suspicion of failure from authority to write
Fence, promote, reconcile and rejoin a former primary

heading.title: Suspected failure
heading.brief: Use a partition between the shop and its primary to show why a timeout cannot prove the writer is dead.

heading.title: One write authority
heading.brief: Describe fencing, leases or quorum authority with their actual enforcement point; identify who rejects an old writer.

heading.title: Promotion and data loss
heading.brief: Choose a candidate from durable and applied history against the service’s loss budget; explain synchronous acknowledgements and residual failure assumptions.

heading.title: A divergent return
heading.brief: Prevent the old primary serving writes, preserve evidence and rewind or reseed it under engine rules; reconcile requests whose outcomes were uncertain.
